cohort: The study participants were two pregnant patients who experienced early-onset oligohydramnios associated with long-term diclofenac exposure.
finding: Amniotic fluid returned to normal after discontinuation of diclofenac in both cases, suggesting a causal relationship between long-term diclofenac use and early-onset oligohydramnios.
gest_age: The pathological findings were detected at gestational weeks 22 and 23.
